station_name: NAPA RIVER NEAR ST. HELENA, CALIF.
notes: Daily maximum and minimum water temperature (°C), water year October 1969 to September 1970, at a stream gaging station (temperature table, so data type follows the stream). No values July 1 to Aug. 7 (probe inoperative). Other distances in the LOCATION paragraph: 0.2 mile upstream from highway bridge, 1.3 miles northeast of Zinfandel, and 2.5 miles east of St. Helena.
